subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: If x + y = 10 and x - y = 2, what is the value of x?
solution: Adding the two equations: (x + y) + (x - y) = 10 + 2 => 2x = 12 => x = 6. Topic (Algebra) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
